title: Payroll and Credit Controller
description:
We are working with a reputable long standing business based in Durham who are looking to recruit into their finance team.

This role will report into the Accounts Manager and will be responsible for both Payroll and Credit Control.

Job Summary / Key Responsibilities:
- Processing of payroll for multiple companies including P11d benefits.
- Pension submissions via Scottish Widows assist me.
- Reconciliation and payment of PAYE and NI.
- Full involvement with the tax year end process.
- Primary contact with the HMRC for all payroll queries.
- Responsible for credit control and sales ledger activities for multiple companies.
- Creating and maintaining customer accounts including the processing of sales invoices.
- Perform ad-hoc tasks as requested by line manager including holiday cover for other team members.

Knowledge and skills:
- Comprehensive knowledge of payroll, preferable Sage 50.
- Experience in processing payroll including reconciliation and payment of PAYE and NI, pension submissions, P11d benefits.
- Sales ledger experience.
- Excellent numeracy, Excel and IT skills.
- Methodical and organised.
- A high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
- Confidentiality.

title: Accounts Payable Assistant
description:
We are looking for an Accounts Payable Assistant to join an established Finance team. This is a high-volume role suited to someone with excellent attention to detail, strong organisational skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment. The role is on a 12-month fixed-term basis, there is potential for permanent thereafter, but that cannot be guaranteed.

Key Responsibilities
- Monitor and manage the Accounts Payable email inbox, ensuring queries are dealt with promptly
- Process associate expense claims through the expense system
- Enter, code and process invoices
- Process payments through various well known banks, including Lloyds & HSBC
- Process reallocation journals accurately and efficiently
- Liaise with overseas colleagues to ensure a high level of service for internal stakeholders.
- Support the wider AP function and contribute to the smooth running of day-to-day processes.

Candidate Requirements
- Ideally 2+ years' Accounts Payable experience desirable
- Previous experience using various AP systems would be desirable
- Experience working within a fast-paced, high-volume environment
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- Adaptable, friendly and sociable, with the ability to build strong relationships across the business.
- Confident working both independently and as part of a wider Finance team.

Role Details
- Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:30am-5:30pm
- Location: Near Gateshead
- Hybrid: 2 days in the office / 3 days working from home

title: Bookkeeper
description:
A well-established and family-owned company in Sunderland are seeking an experienced Bookkeeper to join the team on an initial temporary basis to provide additional support during a particularly busy period.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on finance professional who can quickly integrate into the business and support the day-to-day running of the finance function.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing day-to-day bookkeeping activities
- Processing financial transactions using Sage
- Performing bank reconciliations
- Maintaining and allocating nominal ledger codes
- Supporting the preparation of management accounts
- Assisting with month-end close processes
- Processing purchase and sales ledger transactions
- Investigating and resolving account discrepancies
- Maintaining accurate financial records and documentation
- Providing general finance and administrative support as required

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Previous experience in a Bookkeeper or Accounts role
- Strong working knowledge of Sage
- Experience with bank reconciliations and ledger management
- Understanding of management accounts and month-end procedures
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
- The ability to work independently and manage priorities effectively
- A proactive approach and willingness to support a busy finance team

What's on Offer?
- Immediate start available
- Flexible temporary opportunity with a well-established Sunderland business
- Friendly and supportive working environment
- Opportunity to make an immediate impact during a key period for the organisation

If you're an experienced Bookkeeper looking for your next temporary assignment and can hit the ground running, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Credit Controller
company: Hays Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Your new company
The Opportunity

Hays Accountancy & Finance are delighted to be supporting a highly respected North East organisation in the recruitment of a Credit Controller to join their established finance team.This is an excellent opportunity to join a values-led organisation with a strong reputation for making a positive impact across the UK. Working within a supportive and collaborative finance function, you will play a key role in managing customer accounts, reducing outstanding debt, and maintaining strong client relationships.The successful candidate will be an enthusiastic and proactive Credit Controller who enjoys building relationships whilst ensuring effective collection of outstanding balances.

- Investigate and resolve invoice and payment queries efficiently.

- Maintain accurate customer account records and collection notes.
- Allocate incoming payments and reconcile customer accounts.
- Work closely with internal stakeholders to resolve account discrepancies.
- Produce regular debtor reports and updates for management.
- Support continuous improvements within credit control processes and procedures.
- Ensure all activities are completed in line with company policies and regulatory requirements.

- Previous experience within Credit Control, Accounts Receivable or Collections.
- Strong communication and negotiation skills.
- The ability to build positive relationships with customers and internal stakeholders.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and finance systems.
- A proactive approach with the ability to manage workloads effectively.
- Experience working within a busy finance environment.

- Competitive salary and benefits package.
- Hybrid and flexible working arrangements.
- Generous holiday entitlement.
- Enhanced pension scheme.
- Health and wellbeing initiatives.
- Ongoing learning and development opportunities.
- A supportive and collaborative working environment.
- The opportunity to join an organisation with a strong social purpose and an excellent reputation.
